reading.title: Updating the Planner
reading.text: This morning, Hana opens her planner and checks today's appointment. She moves one task to tomorrow and reviews what she finished yesterday. She looks at this week and next week, then compares them with last week. On the monthly page, she reviews this month, next month, and last month. Before closing the calendar, she checks the date, her work schedule, and the main goals for this year.
